answer: The protocol requires agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits where failed proof of replication triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash of deposited funds. An honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense to maintain the same parity. Like a cosmic nebula of bits, every shard is a critical dependency. The voyage toward identity uniqueness relies on this audit, using an onyx layer of encryption to lock data integrity for 30-day periods.
